title: BEST NEW Iron Farm In Minecraft Bedrock! - NEVER FAIL!
description:
In this video, I will show you how to make this new iron farm for Minecraft, which uses a new box trapping pattern, making the farm extremely stable at a maximum rate of 100% without any issues (except if your server side does something, which can be caused by plugins ) easiest and cheapest iron farm you have ever seen in Minecraft. This farm is compact, easy to build, and extremely fast. It can be built in just a few minutes, making this farm the quickest, easiest, and cheapest iron farm ever built in Minecraft Bedrock.

If you enjoyed this channel, it will focus on high-performance and simple farms that are beyond the bedrock level, so be sure to turn on notifications to stay informed!
